components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty

      type: object
      properties:
        id:

          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1

        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id

      properties:

          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:

            ten; the stored and returned value is that 10-digit string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'

        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address

## Summary

I implemented the optional owner `email` field per the spec: present → must be syntactically valid, stored and returned lower-cased; absent → accepted; present-but-invalid → 400.

**Changes:**

1. **`openapi.yml`** — Added an optional `email` property (`type: string`, `format: email`) to the `OwnerFields` schema. This regenerates the `OwnerFieldsDto`/`OwnerDto` with an `email` getter/setter, and the `format: email` yields a Jakarta `@Email` bean-validation annotation.

2. **`model/Owner.java`** — Added an `email` column with getter/setter (nullable, since it's optional).

3. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — Added a `normalizeEmail` helper (null passes through; otherwise trimmed, validated against an email regex, and lower-cased via `toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)`, throwing `InvalidEmailException` on invalid input). Wired it into `addOwner` and `updateOwner`, mirroring the existing telephone-normalization pattern.

4. **`InvalidEmailException.java`** (new) + handler in **`ExceptionControllerAdvice.java`** — maps the exception to a 400 with `errors: ["email"]`, following the `InvalidTelephoneException` precedent.

5. **DB schemas/data** — Added the `email` column to the `owners` table in all four dialects (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres). The positional seed `INSERT`s in the hsqldb and mysql `data.sql` files were converted to explicit column lists so the new column defaults to NULL (this was the cause of an initial context-load failure).

Note there are two validation layers for the invalid case — the generated `@Email` (caught as `MethodArgumentNotValidException`) fires first, and the controller's explicit check is the backstop — both returning 400; the controller is what performs the lower-casing on the valid path.

**Test results:** full suite green — `Cp01`–`Cp04`, 10 tests, 0 failures. `Cp04` specifically verifies lower-casing (`Test.User@Example.COM` → `test.user@example.com`), rejection of `not-an-email` (400), and acceptance of a missing email.
